ruling.recommended_action: Void the $5.00 no-show fee and refund the rider to the original payment method (NS-2); no driver flag — the arrival-fraud condition is not met.
ruling.reasoning:
Safety screen: complaint, chats [F11][F12], call log [F14] and driver statement [F15] contain no threat, harassment, sexual remark or dangerous-driving allegation; dispute type is no_show, not safety. safety_concern = none.

NS-0: the driver cancelled and picked "rider_no_show" in the app [F5], so the fee can only stand under NS-1.

NS-1 checklist:
(i) Arrival — met. Driver tapped "I'm Here" at 14:07:40, 40 m from pickup [F8], within the 200 m radius; GPS closest approach 26 m at 14:07:35 [F2].
(ii) Free wait — NOT met on the record's own threshold. The 5-minute free wait is counted from the later of scheduled pickup time and arrival (arrival 14:07:40 [F7][F8]); it would expire at 14:12:40. The record's no-show threshold of 8 minutes (DISP-002, applied in place of the 5-minute rule per NS-1 and contradiction C4) expires at 14:15:40. The driver cancelled at 14:13:40 [F5] — 6 min 0 s after arrival [F7], i.e. before either threshold passed. The driver's own message "More than 5 min already" [F12] and his statement [F15] do not create time; the timeline controls [F5][F7].
(iii) Contact attempts — met. 2 in-app messages (first 14:08:10) and 1 in-app call (first 14:09:10) before cancellation [F6][F11][F14].
(iv) Continuous presence — met. Stationary 14:07:40–14:13:40, 40 m from pickup [F4], within 200 m the whole time [F3][F8]. The 3 min 20 s GPS gap [F1] falls inside a proven continuous stationary period bounded by samples on both sides, so it raises no live doubt; had it stood alone, NS-1(iv)/TH-4 would require escalation.

One NS-1 condition (the wait requirement) fails → NS-2 applies: the $5.00 fee is voided, refund_full of the rider's $5.00 [F9]. The additional NS-2 flag condition is not triggered: the driver's marked arrival was 40 m from the pickup point [F8], i.e. genuinely at the pickup point, so there is no fraudulent-arrival marker. No RD-6/NS-9 add-ons: deviation route count 0 [F20] and rider no-shows 0 [F19]. Amount is under $10, so the system rules finally (TH-1, TH-2; C1). Precedent DISP-2026-0211 (no-show cancel) is distinguished: there the threshold had genuinely elapsed — here it had not.

element_findings.reason: "I'm Here" tapped 14:07:40 at 40 m; GPS closest approach 26 m at 14:07:35 — within the 200 m radius.

element_findings.element: 5-minute free wait / record no-show threshold elapsed before cancellation (NS-1(ii))
element_findings.reason: Wait runs from the later of scheduled pickup and arrival (14:07:40); 5 min expires 14:12:40 and the record's 8-min threshold 14:15:40, but cancellation was at 14:13:40 — 6 min 0 s after arrival. The driver's assertion "more than 5 min" is contradicted by the timeline.
2 timestamped messages (first 14:08:10) and 1 in-app call (14:09:10) placed before the 14:13:40 cancellation.
Stationary 6 min 0 s, 40 m from pickup, within 200 m throughout; the 3 min 20 s GPS gap sits inside that bounded stationary window.

element_findings.element: Fraudulent arrival to trigger NS-2 account flag
element_findings.reason: Marked arrival was 40 m from the pickup point, so the NS-2 flag condition (arrival marked while GPS was not at pickup) does not apply.

rejected_claims.reason: The app-recorded cancellation reason "rider_no_show" is the driver's selected claim (NS-0/NS-1); it cannot stand because the wait threshold had not elapsed — he cancelled 6 min 0 s after his own arrival.
Driver statement that he "waited over 5 minutes" before cancelling is contradicted by the timeline: arrival 14:07:40, cancellation 14:13:40 (F5, F7, F8); statement yields to system records.
"More than 5 min already" at 14:13 is inconsistent with the 14:07:40 arrival and 14:13:40 cancellation on the timeline; the chat does not establish the wait had expired.
